description: This is a PHP source file defining the SkillAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. The class implements REST API endpoints for managing 'Skill' entities, including CRUD operations such as getOne, getAll, create, update, and delete, with associated validation rules and service interactions. It serves as an API controller for skill-related operations within the admin plugin.

classes.name: SkillAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing skills, including CRUD operations with validation, service interactions, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the SkillService instance used for business logic related to skills.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a single skill by ID with proper exception handling if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all skills with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Skill entity based on request data and returns the created model.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Skill entity identified by ID with request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple skills based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Populates and saves a Skill entity with data from the request.
